payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy covering: scan left to right, keep track of farthest reachable heater; when current position exceeds current cover, select the farthest-reaching heater seen and increment count.
payload.rationale: The solution implements the classic minimum interval cover greedy algorithm, which selects the heater that extends coverage furthest while covering the leftmost uncovered position. This is proven optimal via an exchange argument.
